changes_from_source: 原帖包含多轮调色和导出反馈；统一为单次完整任务，换用原创 Logo。
checks: 表现立体厚度与金属质感
brief_en: Use logo.svg as the exact silhouette. Extrude or construct a three-dimensional silver metallic logo, light it so its surfaces and depth remain legible, and rotate it between front-facing oblique angles. Add brief deterministic glitch moments. Deliver both a transparent overlay.mov and a dark-background video.mp4 preview. Preserve the holes and negative space of the logo.
brief_zh: 使用 logo.svg 的准确轮廓，制作银色金属立体标志，让灯光清楚表现表面与厚度，进行正面附近的倾斜旋转，并加入短暂且可复现的故障效果。交付透明 overlay.mov 和深色背景预览 video.mp4，保留标志的镂空与负空间。
